title: 高品質アニメ映像。
content:
高品質アニメ映像。
高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックによる、サイバー神社型の映画的高速剣戟。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。回避、破壊、偏向、反撃、最大衝突までを、構え直しや待機を挟まない一つの連続運動として描く。
【参照と人物固定】
image1 is the face reference and identity reference. image2 is the outfit reference and full-body reference, including accessories and weapon. If references conflict, face and identity have priority from image1 ; outfit, full-body design, accessories and weapon have priority from image2 .
image1 は剣士の顔と同一人物性の参照。柔らかく繊細な小さめの顔立ち、17歳の年齢感、紫桃色の大きな瞳、宝石のような虹彩、多層の白いキャッチライト、濃い上まつ毛と柔らかい下まつ毛、目の大きさと間隔、金色の目元差し色、淡い頬の血色、小さな口元、前髪、長いピンクのツインテール、紫の花と結晶の髪飾りを最優先する。image1 の背景は使わない。
image2 は剣士の衣装、装飾、全身、体型、武器の参照。身長160cmほどの細身のシルエット、濃紺と紫の制服調レイヤード衣装、金縁、紫の星型ブローチ、白いプリーツブラウス、紫のリボンタイ、ベルトと腰飾り、紫の重ねプリーツスカートとシアーレイヤー、背面リボン、黒タイツ、花飾り付きの紫黒ヒールブーツ、紫の刀、菱巻きの柄、星型の鍔、紫の房、左腰の鞘を最優先する。image2 の設定表レイアウト、枠線、文字、白背景、複数ポーズは映像へ入れない。
参照が衝突した場合、顔、目、虹彩、顎、前髪、髪色は image1 、衣装、装飾、体型、全身シルエット、刀は image2 を優先する。全編で image1 と image2 が示す同じ一人、same person、same character identity を維持する。
【人物A / Character 1：剣士固定】
剣士は一人だけ。顔立ち、目と虹彩、髪型と髪色、衣装と装備、体型とシルエット、ピンク、紫、金の固有配色を変えない。高速動作中や引きの画でも成人化、平均顔化、無表情な能面化を起こさず、両目、虹彩、まつ毛、頬、金色の目元差し色を保つ。変化してよいのは表情、敵へ向く視線、口元、姿勢、呼吸、髪と衣装の自然な遅れだけ。髪やエフェクトで顔を隠さない。
【人物B / Character 2：Cyber-Oni Sentinel固定】
敵は Cyber-Oni Sentinel 一体だけ。黒金属の重量級フレーム、角付きの面、左右の前腕へ接続された二本の金属爪、シアンのプラズマ排気口、剣士のおよそ二倍の質量、大きく前傾した固有シルエットを変えない。滑らず重心移動で動き、自ら横薙ぎ、偏向、押し返し、爪突きを行う。敵本体を水晶像、結晶人形、霧、抽象物へ変えない。
人物Aと人物Bの顔または面、目、髪または頭部、衣装または装甲、装備、体型、シルエット、固有色を混ぜない。顔の平均化、衣装交換、装備交換、クローン、余計な人物を起こさない。
【画風固定】
レンダリングレーンは3Dトゥーン／セルルックだけ。細く繊細な青紫系の色付き輪郭線。顔、髪、衣装、武器には明快な二段から三段のセルシェーディングと透明感のある中間影。キーライト、影色、発光は剣士固有のピンク、ラベンダー、バイオレットから取り、シアンのネオンは敵と背景の補助色だけに抑える。背景は人物より一段暗くし、人物固有色を画面の主色にする。瞳と髪は多層ハイライト、髪束、まつ毛、刺繍、金縁、リボン、宝石まで高密度。布、革、肌、磨かれた金属、濡れた瓦、ガラスを異なる反射と粗さで描き分ける。背景も瓦の目地、鳥居の金属継ぎ目、ケーブル、蒸気、支柱外装まで劇場版密度を保つ。太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、簡略TVアニメ、汎用3D美少女顔、滑らかなプラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、写実、くすんだ色、画風混合へ変えない。
3D toon/cel-look only: fine blue-violet colored linework; two-to-three-step cel shading; a pink, lavender, violet and gold character color palette; layered eye and hair highlights; high-density fine detail and high-density background detail; distinct material roughness for skin, cloth, leather, polished metal, wet roof tiles and glass. No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.
【武器の実寸・構造・操作固定】
剣士の刀は合計五本。右手で柄だけを握る手持ち刀一本と、念力で操作する四本の浮遊刀。鞘は左腰の一本だけ。五本すべてを image2 の刀と同じ実寸、同じ比率、同じ材質感を持つ日本刀として描く。各刀は全長およそ95〜105cm、刀身70〜75cm、柄23〜28cm。磨かれた暗紫色の金属刀身、連続した直線的な刃先、刃文、切っ先、星型の鍔、菱巻きの柄、柄頭が一本につながった完全な構造で、手持ち刀と浮遊刀の大きさを揃える。静止時も高速移動中も、切っ先から柄頭までの長い金属刀身を主役として明瞭に見せる。
四本の浮遊刀は開始時、剣士の背後へ非対称で奥行き差のある四つの固定待機点に置く。一本は左肩より高い後方、一本は右肩よりさらに高く深い後方、一本は左腰の後方、一本は右膝より低い後方。互いに等間隔にせず、同一平面へ並べず、それぞれの長軸と切っ先を敵へ向ける。人物と刀の間、刀同士の間に常に明瞭な空間を残す。剣士は浮遊刀へ手で触れず、敵へ向けた視線、開いた指、短い手首の返しだけで出発方向を与える。
浮遊刀の発光は金属刀身の刃先と刃文に密着する極細の紫光だけ。静止中は残光を出さない。移動中だけ、金属刀身の後方へ刀身より短い直線的な紫、バイオレット、マゼンタの残光を引く。残光は刀身を置き換えず、切っ先、刃、鍔、柄を隠さない。短剣、小型ナイフ、湾曲した発光片、三日月状の光刃、

en.content:
High-quality anime footage.  
A cinematic high-speed sword fight at a cyber-shrine, rendered in high-density 3D toon/cel-look. Feature-film-level key animation, refined compositing, translucent lighting, and richly detailed background art. Depict evasion, destruction, deflection, counterattack, and the final clash as one continuous motion with no reset into a ready stance or idle pause.

【Reference and character locking】  
image1 is the face reference and identity reference. image2 is the outfit reference and full-body reference, including accessories and weapon. If references conflict, face and identity have priority from image1; outfit, full-body design, accessories, and weapon have priority from image2.  
Prioritize image1 for the swordswoman’s face and identity: a soft, delicate, small face; a 17-year-old look; large purple-pink eyes; jewel-like irises; layered white catchlights; thick upper lashes and soft lower lashes; eye size and spacing; gold accent color around the eyes; faint blush on the cheeks; a small mouth; bangs; long pink twin tails; and purple flower and crystal hair ornaments. Do not use the background from image1.  
image2 is the reference for the swordswoman’s outfit, ornaments, full body, body type, and weapon. Prioritize the slender silhouette of a roughly 160 cm-tall figure; the dark navy and purple uniform-like layered outfit; gold trim; purple star-shaped brooch; white pleated blouse; purple ribbon tie; belt and waist ornaments; layered purple pleated skirt with sheer layers; back ribbon; black tights; purple-black heeled boots with floral ornaments; purple sword; diamond-wrapped hilt; star-shaped guard; purple tassel; and left-hip scabbard. Do not include image2’s layout, borders, text, white background, or multiple poses in the video.  
If references conflict, prioritize image1 for the face, eyes, irises, jaw, bangs, and hair color; prioritize image2 for the outfit, ornaments, body type, full-body silhouette, and sword. Maintain the same person, same character identity shown in image1 and image2 throughout.

【Character A / Character 1: Swordswoman locked】  
There is only one swordswoman. Do not change her facial features, eyes and irises, hairstyle and hair color, outfit and equipment, body type and silhouette, or her signature pink, purple, and gold color palette. Even during fast motion or wide shots, do not make her look older, generic, or mask-like; preserve both eyes, irises, lashes, cheeks, and the gold accent around the eyes. The only things allowed to change are expression, gaze direction toward the enemy, mouth shape, posture, breathing, and the natural lag of hair and clothing. Do not let hair or effects cover her face.

【Character B / Character 2: Cyber-Oni Sentinel locked】  
There is only one enemy: a Cyber-Oni Sentinel. Do not change its heavy black-metal frame, horned mask, two metal claws connected to the left and right forearms, cyan plasma vents, mass roughly twice that of the swordswoman, or its strongly forward-leaning silhouette. It moves by shifting its center of gravity, not by sliding, and performs its own horizontal slashes, deflections, shoves, and claw thrusts. Do not turn the enemy into a crystal statue, crystal doll, mist, or abstract object.  
Do not mix the faces or masks, eyes, hair or head, clothing or armor, equipment, body type, silhouette, or signature colors of Character A and Character B. No averaged faces, outfit swaps, equipment swaps, clones, or extra people.

【Style lock】  
Rendering must be 3D toon / cel-look only. Use thin, delicate blue-violet linework. Faces, hair, clothing, and weapons should have clear two- to three-step cel shading with translucent mid-shadows. Derive key light, shadow color, and glow from the swordswoman’s signature pink, lavender, and violet; keep cyan neon as a secondary color only for the enemy and background. Make the background one step darker than the characters, and let the characters’ signature colors dominate the frame. Eyes and hair should have layered highlights, hair strands, lashes, embroidery, gold trim, ribbons, and jewels rendered with high density. Distinguish cloth, leather, skin, polished metal, wet roof tiles, and glass with different reflections and roughness. The background should also maintain feature-film density down to tile seams, torii metal joints, cables, steam, and pillar cladding. Do not switch to thick black outlines, flat single-layer cel shadows, simplified TV anime, generic 3D pretty-girl faces, smooth plastic CG, low-density backgrounds, semi-realism, realism, dull colors, or mixed styles.  
3D toon/cel-look only: fine blue-violet colored linework; two-to-three-step cel shading; a pink, lavender, violet and gold character color palette; layered eye and hair highlights; high-density fine detail and high-density background detail; distinct material roughness for skin, cloth, leather, polished metal, wet roof tiles and glass. No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.

【Weapon size, structure, and operation lock】  
The swordswoman has five swords in total: one handheld sword gripped only by the hilt in her right hand, and four floating swords controlled by telekinesis. There is only one scabbard, at her left hip. Depict all five as Japanese swords with the same real-world size, proportions, and material feel as the sword in image2. Each sword should be approximately 95–105 cm overall, with a 70–75 cm blade and a 23–28 cm hilt. Show a polished dark-purple metal blade, continuous straight cutting edge, hamon, kissaki, star-shaped guard, diamond-wrapped hilt, and a complete structure with pommel attached, keeping the handheld sword and floating swords the same size. Whether still or moving at high speed, keep the long metal blade from tip to pommel clearly visible as the main subject.  
At the start, place the four floating swords at four fixed, asymmetrical waiting points behind the swordswoman with depth differences. One is behind and higher than the left shoulder, one is farther back and even higher than the right shoulder, one is behind the left hip, and one is behind and lower than the right knee. Do not space them evenly or align them on the same plane; point each sword’s long axis and tip toward the enemy. Always leave clear space between the character and the swords, and between the swords themselves. The swordswoman must not touch the floating swords with her hands; she gives them their launch direction only through her gaze toward the enemy, open fingers, and a short wrist turn.  
The floating swords’ glow is only an extremely thin purple light hugging the blade edge and hamon. They emit no afterglow while stationary. Only while moving do they leave a short, straight afterimage in purple, violet, and magenta behind the metal blade, shorter than the blade itself. The afterimage must not replace the blade or hide the tip, edge, guard, or hilt. Do not turn them into daggers, small knives, curved glowing fragments, crescent-shaped light blades, or glowing toys with only a hilt.  
In normal offense and defense, launch them one at a time; the three that are not moving must remain completely still at separate fixed waiting points, continuing to show their full-size metal blades. Each launched sword must have a start point, an open straight or shallow diagonal path, a single contact point, a new line after deflection, and a stop point. The whole sword moves as one rigid body; do not rotate only the tip. Do not make them orbit around the swordswoman, share a common center, or form closed paths. Do not create a motion where all four rotate at the same angular speed, or form a radial rotating shield, halo, windmill, or propeller.  
In the final maximum clash, use all four swords only once. Even then, each must travel from its own fixed point along a separate open straight or shallow diagonal line, arriving with different depth and slight timing offsets. They must not overlap, merge, align into a cross on the same plane, or become rotating blades. Immediately afterward, each returns along its own separate straight path to its fixed waiting point. The swords must not multiply, disappear, merge, transform, or pass through the swordswoman’s body. The right hand must hold only the hilt behind the guard, with the guard clearly separating the hand and blade.  
The Sentinel’s weapons are only the two metal claws connected to its left and right forearms. They move as a single structure from forearm to wrist to claw tip, and impact force is transmitted from the entire claw back into the torso. Do not give the Sentinel a sword.

【Stage】  
A rooftop temple district at night. Continuous wet tiled roofs, suspended scaffolding, neon torii corridors, cables, and steel pillars are all connected as one space. Thin steam and reflections on wet tiles. Use tile seams, torii gates, and steel pillars as distance and depth references. Compose the scene with close-ups, medium shots, and localized inserts only, keeping the character size large enough to read the swordswoman’s face and the real size of all five swords.

【Combat motion contract】  
Body mechanics must remain readable: supporting leg, center of gravity, hips

es.content:
Imagen de anime de alta calidad.
Combate cinematográfico de espadas a gran velocidad, con estética de santuario cibernético, realizado en 3D toon / cel-look de alta densidad. Animación clave de nivel largometraje, composición de alta calidad, iluminación translúcida y fondos de gran densidad. Representar la evasión, la destrucción, la desviación, el contraataque y la colisión máxima como un único movimiento continuo, sin pausas de reacomodo ni espera.
【Referencias y fijación de personaje】
image1 es la referencia del rostro y de identidad. image2 es la referencia del atuendo y del cuerpo completo, incluidos accesorios y arma. Si las referencias entran en conflicto, el rostro y la identidad tienen prioridad de image1; el atuendo, el diseño corporal completo, los accesorios y el arma tienen prioridad de image2.
image1 es la referencia del rostro de la espadachina y de que es la misma persona. Priorizar un rostro pequeño, suave y delicado, apariencia de 17 años, ojos grandes de tono púrpura rosado, iris con aspecto de joya, múltiples catchlights blancos en capas, pestañas superiores densas y pestañas inferiores suaves, tamaño y separación de los ojos, acentos dorados en el contorno ocular, rubor suave en las mejillas, boca pequeña, flequillo, largas coletas gemelas rosas y adornos capilares de flores moradas y cristal. No usar el fondo de image1.
image2 es la referencia del atuendo, adornos, cuerpo completo, complexión y arma de la espadachina. Priorizar una silueta delgada de unos 160 cm de altura, atuendo en capas estilo uniforme en azul marino oscuro y morado, ribetes dorados, broche morado en forma de estrella, blusa blanca plisada, corbata de lazo morada, cinturón y adornos de cintura, falda plisada morada en capas con capa translúcida, lazo trasero, medias negras, botas de tacón moradas y negras con adornos florales, katana morada, empuñadura con envoltura romboidal, guarda en forma de estrella, borla morada y vaina en la cadera izquierda. No incluir en el video el diseño de tabla, bordes, texto, fondo blanco ni múltiples poses de image2.
Si las referencias entran en conflicto, priorizar rostro, ojos, iris, mandíbula, flequillo y color de cabello de image1; y atuendo, adornos, complexión, silueta de cuerpo completo y espada de image2. Mantener durante toda la pieza la misma persona, same person, same character identity, indicada por image1 e image2.
【人物A / Character 1：espadachina fija】
Solo hay una espadachina. No cambiar sus rasgos faciales, ojos e iris, peinado y color de cabello, atuendo y equipo, complexión y silueta, ni su paleta exclusiva de rosa, morado y dorado. Incluso en movimientos rápidos o en planos abiertos, no hacerla parecer adulta, genérica ni de rostro inexpresivo; conservar ambos ojos, iris, pestañas, mejillas y los acentos dorados del contorno ocular. Lo único que puede cambiar es la expresión, la mirada hacia el enemigo, la boca, la postura, la respiración y el retraso natural del cabello y la ropa. No ocultar el rostro con el cabello ni con efectos.
【人物B / Character 2：Cyber-Oni Sentinel fijo】
Solo hay un enemigo, un Cyber-Oni Sentinel. No cambiar su armazón pesado de metal negro, la máscara con cuernos, las dos garras metálicas conectadas a ambos antebrazos, las salidas de plasma cian, la masa aproximada del doble que la espadachina ni su silueta inclinada hacia delante. Se mueve sin deslizarse, mediante desplazamiento del centro de gravedad, y realiza por sí mismo barridos laterales, desviaciones, empujes de retorno y embestidas con las garras. No convertir al enemigo en estatua de cristal, muñeco de cristal, niebla ni objeto abstracto.
No mezclar el rostro o máscara, ojos, cabello o cabeza, atuendo o armadura, equipo, complexión, silueta ni colores propios de los personajes A y B. No generar rostros genéricos, cambios de vestuario, intercambio de equipo, clones ni personajes extra.
【画風固定】
La línea de renderizado debe ser solo 3D toon / cel-look. Contornos finos y delicados en tonos azul violáceo. En rostro, cabello, ropa y arma, usar cel shading claro de dos a tres niveles y sombras intermedias translúcidas. La luz principal, el color de sombra y el brillo deben tomar como base el rosa, lavanda y violeta propios de la espadachina; reservar el neón cian solo como color secundario del enemigo y del fondo. Hacer el fondo un tono más oscuro que los personajes y convertir los colores propios del personaje en el color dominante de la pantalla. Ojos y cabello con múltiples capas de brillo, mechones, pestañas, bordados, ribetes dorados, lazos y joyas en alta densidad. Diferenciar tela, cuero, piel, metal pulido, tejas mojadas y vidrio mediante distintos reflejos y rugosidades. Mantener también el fondo con densidad de largometraje: juntas de las tejas, uniones metálicas del torii, cables, vapor y revestimiento de los pilares. No cambiar a contornos negros gruesos, sombras planas de una sola capa, anime TV simplificado, rostro genérico de chica 3D, CG plástico liso, fondos de baja densidad, semirrealismo, realismo, colores apagados ni mezcla de estilos.
3D toon/cel-look only: fine blue-violet colored linework; two-to-three-step cel shading; a pink, lavender, violet and gold character color palette; layered eye and hair highlights; high-density fine detail and high-density background detail; distinct material roughness for skin, cloth, leather, polished metal, wet roof tiles and glass. No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.
【武器の実寸・構造・操作固定】
La espadachina tiene un total de cinco espadas. Una espada empuñada con la mano derecha, sujetando solo la empuñadura, y cuatro espadas flotantes controladas por telequinesis. Solo hay una vaina, en la cadera izquierda. Representar las cinco como katanas japonesas con las mismas dimensiones reales, proporciones y sensación de material que la espada de image2. Cada espada mide aproximadamente 95 a 105 cm en total, con hoja de 70 a 75 cm y empuñadura de 23 a 28 cm. Hoja metálica pulida de color púrpura oscuro, filo recto y continuo, hamon, punta, guarda en forma de estrella, empuñadura con envoltura romboidal y pomo como una estructura completa y conectada, igualando el tamaño entre la espada en mano y las flotantes. Tanto en reposo como en movimiento rápido, mostrar con claridad la larga hoja metálica desde la punta hasta el pomo como protagonista.
Al inicio, las cuatro espadas flotantes se colocan detrás de la espadachina en cuatro puntos fijos de espera, asimétricos y con distinta profundidad. Una queda detrás y más alta que el hombro izquierdo, otra detrás y aún más alta y profunda que el hombro derecho, otra detrás de la cadera izquierda y otra detrás, más baja que la rodilla derecha. No colocarlas a igual distancia ni en un mismo plano; orientar sus ejes largos y sus puntas hacia el enemigo. Mantener siempre un espacio claro entre la persona y las espadas, y entre las espadas entre sí. La espadachina no toca las espadas flotantes con la mano; solo les da dirección inicial con la mirada hacia el enemigo, los dedos abiertos y un breve giro de muñeca.
El brillo de las espadas flotantes consiste solo en una línea ultrafina de luz púrpura adherida al filo y al hamon de la hoja metálica. En reposo no dejan estela. Solo en movimiento dejan detrás de la hoja una estela recta, más corta que la propia hoja, en púrpura, violeta y magenta. La estela no sustituye la hoja ni oculta la punta, el filo, la guarda o la empuñadura. No convertirlas en dagas, cuchillos pequeños, fragmentos luminosos curvos, hojas de luz en forma de media luna ni juguetes luminosos con solo la empuñadura.
En los intercambios normales, salen de una en una; las tres que no se mueven permanecen completamente inmóviles en sus puntos fijos separados, mostrando su hoja metálica a tamaño real. La espada que sale debe tener siempre punto de partida, línea abierta recta o ligeramente diagonal, un único punto de contacto, nueva línea tras la desviación y punto de parada. Toda la espada se mueve como un solo cuerpo rígido; no girar solo la punta. No orbitar alrededor de la espadachina, no tener un centro

fr.content:
映映像 d’animation de haute qualité.  
Combat cinématographique rapide au sabre, de type sanctuaire cybernétique, rendu en 3D toon / cel-look à haute densité. Animation clé de niveau long métrage, compositing soigné, éclairage transparent, décors de fond très détaillés. Décrire l’esquive, la destruction, la déviation, la contre-attaque et la collision maximale comme un seul mouvement continu, sans reprise de garde ni temps d’attente.

【Références et fixation du personnage】  
image1 est la référence du visage et de l’identité. image2 est la référence de la tenue et du corps entier, y compris les accessoires et l’arme. En cas de conflit entre les références, le visage et l’identité priment sur image1 ; la tenue, le design du corps entier, les accessoires et l’arme priment sur image2.

고품질 애니메이션 영상.
고밀도 3D 토온/셀룩으로 구현한, 사이버 신사풍의 영화적 고속 검격. 극장판급 키 애니메이션, 고급스러운 컴포지트, 투명감 있는 조명, 밀도 높은 배경 미술. 회피, 파괴, 편향, 반격, 최대 충돌까지를, 자세를 다시 잡거나 대기하는 구간 없이 하나의 연속 동작으로 그린다.
【참조와 인물 고정】
image1은 얼굴 레퍼런스이자 동일인물성 레퍼런스다. image2는 의상 레퍼런스이자 전신 레퍼런스로, 액세서리와 무기까지 포함한다. 레퍼런스가 충돌하면 얼굴과 동일인물성은 image1을 우선하고, 의상, 전신 디자인, 액세서리와 무기는 image2를 우선한다.
image1은 검사의 얼굴과 동일인물성의 참조다. 부드럽고 섬세한 작은 얼굴형, 17세 정도의 연령감, 보라빛이 도는 분홍색의 큰 눈, 보석 같은 홍채, 여러 겹의 흰 캐치라이트, 짙은 윗속눈썹과 부드러운 아랫속눈썹, 눈의 크기와 간격, 금색의 눈가 포인트, 옅은 볼 혈색, 작은 입, 앞머리, 긴 핑크 트윈테일, 보라색 꽃과 결정 장식의 머리장식을 최우선으로 한다. image1의 배경은 사용하지 않는다.
image2는 검사의 의상, 장식, 전신, 체형, 무기의 참조다. 키 약 160cm의 슬림한 실루엣, 짙은 남색과 보라색의 제복풍 레이어드 의상, 금색 테두리, 보라색 별 모양 브로치, 흰색 플리츠 블라우스, 보라색 리본 타이, 벨트와 허리 장식, 보라색 겹플리츠 스커트와 시어 레이어, 등쪽 리본, 검은 타이츠, 꽃 장식이 달린 보라-검정 힐 부츠, 보라색 칼, 마름모 감기 손잡이, 별 모양의 가드, 보라색 술, 왼쪽 허리의 칼집을 최우선으로 한다. image2의 설정표 레이아웃, 테두리선, 문자, 흰 배경, 여러 포즈는 영상에 넣지 않는다.
레퍼런스가 충돌할 경우 얼굴, 눈, 홍채, 턱, 앞머리, 머리색은 image1을, 의상, 장식, 체형, 전신 실루엣, 칼은 image2를 우선한다. 전체를 통해 image1과 image2가 가리키는 같은 한 사람, same person, same character identity를 유지한다.
【인물 A / Character 1: 검사 고정】
검사는 한 명뿐이다. 얼굴형, 눈과 홍채, 헤어스타일과 머리색, 의상과 장비, 체형과 실루엣, 핑크, 보라, 금의 고유 배색을 바꾸지 않는다. 고속 동작 중이나 롱샷에서도 성인화, 평균화된 얼굴, 무표정한 가면화가 일어나지 않도록 하고, 양쪽 눈, 홍채, 속눈썹, 볼, 금색의 눈가 포인트를 유지한다. 바뀌어도 되는 것은 표정, 적을 향한 시선, 입가, 자세, 호흡, 머리카락과 의상의 자연스러운 지연뿐이다. 머리카락이나 이펙트로 얼굴을 가리지 않는다.
【인물 B / Character 2: Cyber-Oni Sentinel 고정】
적은 Cyber-Oni Sentinel 한 기뿐이다. 흑금속의 중량급 프레임, 뿔 달린 가면, 좌우 전완에 연결된 두 개의 금속 클로, 시안색 플라즈마 배기구, 검사보다 약 두 배의 질량, 크게 앞으로 기운 고유 실루엣을 바꾸지 않는다. 미끄러지지 않고 무게중심 이동으로 움직이며, 스스로 횡베기, 편향, 밀어내기, 클로 찌르기를 한다. 적 본체를 수정상, 결정 인형, 안개, 추상물로 바꾸지 않는다.
인물 A와 인물 B의 얼굴 또는 가면, 눈, 머리카락 또는 머리, 의상 또는 장갑, 장비, 체형, 실루엣, 고유 색을 섞지 않는다. 얼굴의 평균화, 의상 교체, 장비 교체, 클론, 불필요한 인물을 발생시키지 않는다.
【화풍 고정】
렌더링 레인은 3D 토온/셀룩만 사용한다. 가늘고 섬세한 청보라 계열의 컬러 라인. 얼굴, 머리카락, 의상, 무기에는 명확한 2~3단계 셀 셰이딩과 투명감 있는 중간 그림자. 키라이트, 그림자색, 발광은 검사 고유의 핑크, 라벤더, 바이올렛에서 가져오고, 시안 네온은 적과 배경의 보조색으로만 제한한다. 배경은 인물보다 한 단계 어둡게 하고, 인물 고유색을 화면의 주색으로 삼는다. 눈동자와 머리카락은 다층 하이라이트, 머리카락 가닥, 속눈썹, 자수, 금색 테두리, 리본, 보석까지 고밀도로 표현한다. 천, 가죽, 피부, 광택 금속, 젖은 기와, 유리를 서로 다른 반사와 거칠기로 구분해 그린다. 배경도 기와의 이음새, 도리이의 금속 접합부, 케이블, 증기, 지지대 외장까지 극장판 밀도를 유지한다. 두꺼운 검은 윤곽선, 평면적인 단층 셀 그림자, 단순화된 TV 애니, 범용 3D 미소녀 얼굴, 매끈한 플라스틱 CG, 저밀도 배경, 반사실, 사실, 탁한 색, 화풍 혼합으로 바꾸지 않는다.

No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.
【무기의 실사이즈·구조·조작 고정】
검사의 칼은 총 다섯 자루다. 오른손으로 손잡이만 쥐는 휴대 칼 한 자루와, 염력으로 조작하는 네 자루의 부유 칼. 칼집은 왼쪽 허리의 한 자루만 있다. 다섯 자루 모두를 image2의 칼과 같은 실사이즈, 같은 비율, 같은 재질감을 가진 일본도로 그린다. 각 칼은 전체 길이 약 95~105cm, 칼날 70~75cm, 손잡이 23~28cm. 광택 있는 짙은 보라색 금속 칼날, 연속된 직선형 날끝, 하몬, 칼끝, 별 모양의 가드, 마름모 감기 손잡이, 손잡이 끝이 하나로 이어진 완전한 구조로, 휴대 칼과 부유 칼의 크기를 맞춘다. 정지 시에도 고속 이동 중에도, 칼끝부터 손잡이 끝까지의 긴 금속 칼날을 주인공으로 분명하게 보이게 한다.

image1 is the face reference and identity reference. image2 is the outfit reference and full-body reference, including accessories and weapon. If references conflict, face and identity have priority from image1 ; outfit, full-body design, accessories and weapon have priority from image2 .

【人物B / Character 2：Cyber-Oni Sentinel固定】
Há apenas um inimigo, o Cyber-Oni Sentinel. Não altere a estrutura pesada em metal negro, a máscara com chifres, as duas garras metálicas conectadas aos antebraços esquerdo e direito, as saídas de plasma ciano, a massa de cerca de duas vezes a do espadachim, nem a silhueta única fortemente inclinada para a frente. Ele se move sem deslizar, usando transferência de peso, e executa por conta própria golpes laterais, deflexões, empurrões e investidas com as garras. Não transforme o inimigo em estátua de cristal, boneco de cristal, névoa ou objeto abstrato.
Não misture o rosto ou a máscara, olhos, cabelo ou cabeça, roupa ou armadura, equipamento, tipo físico, silhueta ou cores exclusivas de Personagem A e Personagem B. Não faça média de rostos, troca de roupas, troca de equipamentos, clones ou personagens extras.
【画风固定】
A renderização deve ser apenas em 3D toon/cel-look. Contornos coloridos finos e delicados em tons azul-violeta. Sombras cel nítidas em duas a três etapas, com sombras intermediárias translúcidas em rosto, cabelo, roupa e arma. A luz principal, as sombras e o brilho devem vir da paleta exclusiva do espadachim — rosa, lavanda e violeta —, enquanto o neon ciano deve ficar apenas como cor auxiliar do inimigo e do fundo. O fundo deve ser um tom mais escuro que os personagens, e as cores exclusivas do personagem devem ser a principal cor da tela. Íris e cabelo com highlights em múltiplas camadas, fios de cabelo, cílios, bordados, detalhes dourados, fitas e joias em alta densidade. Diferencie tecido, couro, pele, metal polido, telhas molhadas e vidro por reflexos e rugosidades distintos. O fundo também deve manter densidade de nível cinematográfico, incluindo rejuntes das telhas, junções metálicas do torii, cabos, vapor e revestimento dos pilares. Não altere para contornos pretos grossos, sombra cel plana de camada única, anime de TV simplificado, rosto genérico de garota 3D, CG plástico liso, fundo de baixa densidade, semirrealismo, realismo, cores opacas ou mistura de estilos.
3D toon/cel-look only: fine blue-violet colored linework; two-to-three-step cel shading; a pink, lavender, violet and gold character color palette; layered eye and hair highlights; high-density fine detail and high-density background detail; distinct material roughness for skin, cloth, leather, polished metal, wet roof tiles and glass. No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.
【武器の実寸・構造・操作固定】
A espada do espadachim tem cinco lâminas no total. Uma lâmina empunhada, segurada apenas pelo cabo na mão direita, e quatro lâminas flutuantes controladas por telecinese. Há apenas uma bainha, na cintura esquerda. Desenhe as cinco como katanas japonesas com as mesmas dimensões reais, proporções e sensação de material da espada de image2 . Cada espada deve ter cerca de 95 a 105 cm de comprimento total, 70 a 75 cm de lâmina e 23 a 28 cm de cabo. Lâmina metálica polida em roxo-escuro, fio contínuo e reto, hamon, kissaki, tsuba em forma de estrela, cabo com enrolamento em losango e pomo em uma estrutura completa e contínua, mantendo o mesmo tamanho entre a espada empunhada e as flutuantes. Tanto parada quanto em movimento rápido, a longa lâmina metálica do kissaki ao pomo deve permanecer claramente visível como protagonista.
As quatro lâminas flutuantes, no início, ficam em quatro pontos de espera fixos, assimétricos e com diferença de profundidade atrás do espadachim. Uma fica atrás e acima do ombro esquerdo, uma fica ainda mais alta e mais ao fundo atrás do ombro direito, uma fica atrás da cintura esquerda e uma fica atrás, abaixo do joelho direito. Não as alinhe em intervalos iguais, não as coloque no mesmo plano e aponte o eixo longitudinal e o kissaki de cada uma para o inimigo. Sempre deixe um espaço claro entre o personagem e as espadas, e entre as próprias espadas. O espadachim não toca nas lâminas flutuantes com as mãos; ele apenas dá a direção de partida com o olhar para o inimigo, os dedos abertos e um breve giro do punho.
O brilho das lâminas flutuantes deve ser apenas uma luz roxa finíssima aderida ao fio e ao hamon da lâmina metálica. Quando paradas, não deixam rastro. Só em movimento, deixam um rastro reto, mais curto que a lâmina, em roxo, violeta e magenta atrás da lâmina metálica. O rastro não substitui

zh.content:
高品质动画影像。  
以高密度 3D toon / cel-look 呈现的、赛博神社风格电影级高速剑戟。剧场版级别的关键动画、精良的合成、通透的照明、密度极高的背景美术。将回避、破坏、偏向、反击、直至最大碰撞，描绘成一段不插入重新摆架或待机的连续运动。  
【参考与人物固定】  
image1 is the face reference and identity reference. image2 is the outfit reference and full-body reference, including accessories and weapon. If references conflict, face and identity have priority from image1 ; outfit, full-body design, accessories and weapon have priority from image2 .  
image1 是剑士的脸部与同一人物性参照。优先保持柔和细腻的小脸、17 岁的年龄感、紫桃色的大眼睛、宝石般的虹膜、多层白色高光、浓密上睫毛与柔软下睫毛、眼睛大小与间距、金色眼周点缀、淡淡的脸颊血色、小巧的嘴部、刘海、长粉色双马尾、紫色花朵与结晶发饰。不要使用 image1 的背景。  
image2 是剑士的服装、装饰、全身、体型、武器参照。优先保持约 160cm 的纤细轮廓、深蓝与紫色的制服风分层服装、金边、紫色星形胸针、白色褶皱衬衫、紫色领结、腰带与腰饰、紫色叠层百褶裙与半透明层、背部蝴蝶结、黑色连裤袜、带花饰的紫黑色高跟靴、紫色刀、菱形缠柄、星形护手、紫色流苏、左腰刀鞘。不要把 image2 的设定表版式、边框、文字、白背景、多个姿势带入影像。  
如果参考发生冲突，脸、眼睛、虹膜、下巴、刘海、发色以 image1 为准；服装、装饰、体型、全身轮廓、刀以 image2 为准。全程保持 image1 与 image2 所示的同一个人、same person、same character identity。  
【人物A / Character 1：剑士固定】  
剑士只有一人。脸部、眼睛与虹膜、发型与发色、服装与装备、体型与轮廓、粉、紫、金的专属配色都不能改变。即使在高速动作或远景中，也不要出现成人化、平均脸化、无表情面具化；要保留双眼、虹膜、睫毛、脸颊、金色眼周点缀。允许变化的只有表情、朝向敌人的视线、嘴部、姿势、呼吸，以及头发和衣装的自然滞后。不要让头发或特效遮住脸。  
【人物B / Character 2：Cyber-Oni Sentinel 固定】  
敌人只有一体 Cyber-Oni Sentinel。不要改变其黑金属重型框架、带角面具、连接到左右前臂的两只金属爪、青色等离子排气口、约为剑士两倍的质量、以及明显前倾的专属轮廓。它以重心转移而非滑行移动，并主动进行横扫、偏向、推回、爪击。不要把敌体变成水晶像、结晶人偶、雾气或抽象物。  
不要混合人物A与人物B的脸或面具、眼睛、头发或头部、服装或装甲、装备、体型、轮廓、专属颜色。不要出现脸部平均化、换装、换装备、克隆或多余人物。  
【画风固定】  
渲染仅限 3D toon / cel-look。使用细而精致的蓝紫系彩色描边。脸、头发、服装、武器采用清晰的两到三段式 cel shading 与通透的中间阴影。主光、阴影色、发光取自剑士专属的粉色、薰衣草色、紫罗兰色；青色霓虹只作为敌人与背景的辅助色。背景比人物暗一档，让人物专属色成为画面主色。眼睛与头发要有多层高光，发束、睫毛、刺绣、金边、丝带、宝石都要高密度。布料、皮革、皮肤、抛光金属、湿瓦、玻璃要以不同反射与粗糙度区分。背景也要保持剧场版密度，包括瓦片缝、鸟居金属接缝、电缆、蒸汽、支柱外装。不要变成粗黑轮廓、平坦单层 cel 阴影、简化 TV 动画、通用 3D 美少女脸、光滑塑料 CG、低密度背景、半写实、写实、灰暗色调或风格混合。  
3D toon/cel-look only: fine blue-violet colored linework; two-to-three-step cel shading; a pink, lavender, violet and gold character color palette; layered eye and hair highlights; high-density fine detail and high-density background detail; distinct material roughness for skin, cloth, leather, polished metal, wet roof tiles and glass. No thick outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-detail backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors or style mixing.  
【武器的实寸・结构・操作固定】  
剑士的刀总计五把。右手握柄的持刀一把，以及用念力操控的四把浮游刀。刀鞘只有左腰一把。五把都要画成与 image2 中的刀相同实寸、相同比例、相同材质感的日本刀。每把刀全长约 95〜105cm，刀身 70〜75cm，柄 23〜28cm。要呈现抛光的深紫色金属刀身、连续直线的刃缘、刃文、切尖、星形护手、菱形缠柄、连成一体的柄头结构，并让持刀与浮游刀的大小一致。无论静止还是高速移动，都要清楚展示从切尖到柄头的长金属刀身。  
四把浮游刀在开始时，置于剑士背后四个不对称、具有深度差的固定待机点。一把在左肩后方更高处，一把在右肩后方更高更深处，一把在左腰后方，一把在右膝后方更低处。它们彼此不等距，不排成同一平面，各自的长轴与切尖都朝向敌人。人物与刀之间、刀与刀之间始终保留清晰空间。剑士不以手触碰浮游刀，只通过朝向敌人的视线、张开的手指、短促的手腕翻转来赋予出发方向。  
浮游刀的发光只限于紧贴金属刀身刃缘与刃文的极细紫光。静止时不留残光。只有在移动中，才在金属刀身后方拖出比刀身更短的直线状紫色、紫罗兰色、品红色残光。残光不能取代刀身，也不能遮住切尖、刀刃、护手、刀柄。不要把它们变成短剑、小刀、弯曲发光片、新月形光刃或只有柄的发光玩具。  
在常规攻防中，一次只发出一把；其余三把保持在各自固定待机点完全静止，并持续展示实寸金属刀身。发出的那一把必须具备出发点、展开的直线或浅斜线、单一接触点、偏向后的新直线、停止点。整把刀作为一个刚体运动，不要只让刀尖旋转。不要围绕剑士周回，不要有共同中心，不要形成闭合轨道。不要出现四把刀以相同角速度旋转、放射状旋转盾、光环、风车或螺旋桨。  
在终盘的最大碰撞中只使用一次四把全开。即便如此，也要从四个固定点分别沿着不同的开放直线或浅斜线发出，以不同深度和轻微时间差到达。它们彼此不重叠
